metadata.description: The Terminal concern's conformance rows (P01, R01-R03, T01-T10 at concern level): createTerminalConcern over a MessageChannel port speaking the validated wire, into the real shell service, the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash in a PTY. The services host's frame routing stays proven by desktop:test:terminal-conformance. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.
